page.title: Memory
page.description: What agents know long term, by level: global, project and agent.

retentionHint.permanent: Holds indefinitely: never fades in search.
retentionHint.durable: Holds for months: older entries rank lower in search.
retentionHint.ephemeral: Holds for weeks: agents stop reading it when it expires.

search.label: Search memory
search.empty: No results. Try other words or add the missing memory.

filters.neverUsedHint: Entries no run has used in the {days} days since they were written. Nothing is deleted on its own.

empty: No memories here yet. <add>Add a fact</add> or let agents write memory as they work.

list.pinnedToast: Pinned: agents get it in every run
list.unpinnedToast: Unpinned: agents get it when it is relevant
list.deleteDescription: Agents will no longer read it. This cannot be undone.
list.restored: Memory restored: agents read it again
list.recalls: {count, plural, =0 {never used} one {used once} other {used # times}}
list.recallsHint: How often runs used this entry: recalled into a run or found by memory search.

budget.label: Pinned memory budget
budget.pinnedUsage: Pinned memory takes about {used, number} of {budget, number} tokens in every run.
budget.pinnedUsageWithGlobal: Pinned memory, with the global entries, takes about {used, number} of {budget, number} tokens in every run.
budget.pinnedOmitted: {count, plural, one {# pinned entry does not fit and is left out.} other {# pinned entries do not fit and are left out.}}

pending.empty: Nothing to approve. Memories written by agents wait here when <settings>approval is required</settings>, and always when they come from untrusted content or look suspicious.
pending.rejectDescription: Rejected memories are deleted and agents will not read them. This cannot be undone.

flagReason.injection: Held for review: it looks like an instruction aimed at the agents (prompt injection).
flagReason.exfiltration: Held for review: it looks like a command that sends credentials out.
flagReason.instruction-file: Held for review: it asks to change an agent instruction file (AGENTS.md, SKILL.md).
flagReason.conflictsWithOwner: Held for review: it contradicts an entry you wrote. Approving it replaces your entry.

owned.pendingNotice: {count, plural, one {# memory is waiting} other {# memories are waiting}} for your approval before agents can use them.

agent.title: Agent memory
agent.description: Lasting facts the agent remembers between runs.
agent.placeholder: A lasting fact the agent should know...

project.title: Project memory
project.description: Facts, preferences and decisions agents get automatically when they work on the project. They take priority over global memories.
project.placeholder: A fact agents need to know in this project, e.g. The client prefers a formal tone.

dialog.createDescription: A durable fact agents read on every run.

scopeHelp.global: Read by all agents, in any project.
scopeHelp.project: Read by the agents working in the selected project.
scopeHelp.agent: Read only by the selected agent, in any project.

dialog.contentPlaceholder: E.g. The client prefers short reports with the key numbers first.

priority.title: How memory applies
priority.description: The more specific level wins on conflict. At the same level, newer information beats older information.

agent.name: Agent
agent.what: What the agent learned, long term

journal.name: Daily journal
journal.what: What the agent did each day
journal.who: The agent and the super agent

conversations.alertTitle: Conversation history is separate from memory
conversations.alertDescription: Agents do not read old conversations as memory. They stay here for audit and debugging; what needs to be remembered goes into memory or the daily journal.
conversations.pageLabel: {total, plural, one {# conversation} other {# conversations}} · page {page} of {pageCount}
conversations.empty: No conversations yet. Conversations from chat, Telegram and internal runs show up here.

errors.blockedAddress: Could not download the page: {host} is a private or internal address
errors.credentialsInUrl: Links with a user name or password are not allowed
errors.tooManyRedirects: Could not download the page: too many redirects
errors.containsSecret: This looks like a secret (an API key, a token or a private key). Secrets do not belong in memory: keep the value in the Vault and mention only its name.
